title: Alan A. Stone Professor of Law
bio: Jon Hanson is the Alan A. Stone Professor of Law and the Director of the Systemic Justice Project. Hanson graduated from Yale Law School in 1990. Before joining the Harvard Law School faculty in 1992, Hanson clerked for Judge José A. Cabranes and was a Post-Doctoral Fellow at Yale Law School. Hanson’s teaching and scholarship […]
